scope: Research source-priority replacement only. BaoStock unadjusted completed daily data first; Tushare is optional fallback and cross-check, not a required credential gate. No production activation or strategy change.
rules: Preserve original frozen dates, numeric thresholds, v1 artifacts and incomplete verdict. Do not amend v1 or mark strategy checklist complete.

BaoStock daily frequency d, adjustflag 3, exact code/date/batch, observed after target close, positive finite close/preclose and nonnegative volume/amount are required. Source close and preclose must agree with the immutable baseline within 0.005.

Only explicit tradestatus 0/1 and isST 0/1 are facts. tradestatus 0 proves suspension only with zero trading volume/amount. tradestatus 1 proves non-suspension only with positive volume/amount. Missing or contradictory states remain None.
BaoStock provides dated ST and suspension facts; they never manufacture an ordinary trading regime, listing proof or limit prices. Invalid/mismatched source rows cannot yield safe False.

Tushare fallback is attempted only on absent BaoStock evidence and only from valid v1 dated evidence already supplied in memory. No credential/config access or automatic Tushare network requests; a malformed/conflicting BaoStock record does not trigger a safety fallback.
An explicit BaoStock risk-positive fact cannot be overwritten by fallback False. Valid supplied cross-source contradictions remain None with a conflict reason.

Normal limits still require dated complete listing/calendar evidence, exclusion of first five sessions, and exchange special-regime proof. ST/suspension/unsupported boards/unknown regimes keep limit states None. Decimal HALF_UP to cents, ordinary main-board 10 percent and ChiNext 20 percent only.
Retain real source retrieval time, original baseline identity, raw hashes and per-field provenance. Historical retrieval is retrospective research, not proof of historical decision-time availability.
comparison: Compare every supported row of every date, report coverage, unknowns, positives, discrepancies and full tuple completeness. Small-budget probes are not acceptance or a formal list.
Preserve mandatory dated Eastmoney companion and AKShare checks. Pool absence never proves False; current companion responses cannot reconstruct historical snapshots.

BaoStock cannot serve as an independent reference for fields derived from that same BaoStock response. Tushare fallback cannot validate itself either. Count same-source references separately, not as agreement or reference coverage.
Optional tushare:dated-risk references may compare ST/suspension only with dated full source evidence, matching date/code/batch/close and raw evidence hash.
Missing mandatory inputs mean incomplete. Unsafe False or unexplained disagreement means fail. Passing tests do not license live sources.
activation: User confirms real comparison evidence before adding exact source/version/field licenses, formal provider/persistence integration, activation tests, verification/release checks and main merge. Show diff/tests before backed-up plugin-only deployment.
